```{r read data}

lizard <- read.csv( "lizard-climate.csv", fileEncoding = "latin1")

names(lizard)
view(lizard)
```

```{r data summary}

summary_table <- map_dfr(names(lizard), function(v) {

  x <- lizard[[v]]

  if (is.numeric(x)) {

    tibble(
      Variable = v,
      Type = "Numeric",
      Min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      Max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      Categories = NA_character_
    )

  } else if (is.factor(x) || is.character(x)) {

    tibble(
      Variable = v,
      Type = "Categorical",
      Min = NA_real_,
      Max = NA_real_,
      Mean = NA_real_,
      Categories = paste(unique(na.omit(x)), collapse = ", ")
    )

  } else {
    NULL
  }
})

View(summary_table)

```


```{r}
cor_matrix <- lizard %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  cor()
corrplot(cor_matrix)
```

```{r}

split_lizard <- initial_split(lizard, prop = 0.75, strata = "Mean.Clutch.Size")
train_lizard <- analysis(split_lizard)
test_lizard  <- assessment(split_lizard)

maximal_tree <- rpart(
  Mean.Clutch.Size ~  Average.Female.adult.weight..g. + 
    Offspring.SVL..mm.+
    Mode.of.reproduction +
    Clutch.Frequency +
    Foraging.Mode +
    Distribution +
    Prefered.Habitat.Type +
    precip_seasonality+
    temp_seasonality+
    mean_annual_temp,
  data = train_lizard,
  method = "class",
  control = rpart.control(minsplit = 2, cp = 0.018, xval = 10)
)

rpart.plot(maximal_tree)
```


```{r}
lizard_climate <- read.csv("lizard-climate.csv")
head(lizard)
```

```{r}
#Linear model

m1 <- glm(
  Mean.Clutch.Size ~ Average.Female.adult.weight..g. + 
    Offspring.SVL..mm.+
    Mode.of.reproduction +
    Clutch.Frequency +
    Foraging.Mode +
    Distribution +
    Prefered.Habitat.Type +
    precip_seasonality+
    temp_seasonality+
    mean_annual_temp
    ,
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  data = lizard
)

m2 <- glm(
  Mean.Clutch.Size ~ Average.Female.adult.weight..g. + 
    Offspring.SVL..mm.+
    Mode.of.reproduction +
    Clutch.Frequency +
    Foraging.Mode +
    Distribution +
    Prefered.Habitat.Type, 
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  data = lizard
)

summary(m1)
summary(m2)

anova(m1)
anova(m2)

lizard$abs_latitude <- abs(lizard$Latitude)

plot(lizard$Mean.Clutch.Size, lizard$mean_annual_temp)
plot(Mean.Clutch.Size ~ abs_latitude, data = lizard)


```

data_num <- lizard %>% 
select_if(is.numeric)
corr = cor(data_num, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
